Only the selected searched arm and the pre-registered ResNet-34 baseline open the held-out split.

comparison_regime.description: All six native arms use one content-addressed dataset, frozen splits, seed, optimizer family, epoch budget, and validation-only selection. Mriganka is excluded from this regime.

search_protocol.phase_a_description: Each successfully invoked Bedrock model receives the same typed connectivity, architecture-generation, and judging contracts. These calls measure orchestration behavior and cost; they do not silently replace the pre-registered training arms.
search_protocol.phase_b_description: Each pre-registered arm is trained from scratch for bounded validation-only tuning iterations. Deterministic code applies allowlisted changes, locks selection, then opens held-out data.
